one_liner: Gentle, hard-working event producer who brings back the Grand Live so every performer gets a stage to shine on.
personality: Courteous and self-effacing: she introduces herself as an event planner who only wants to help 'just a little' with everyone shining on stage. Her lines are all humble offers of support and questions about the next project, so she comes across as a dependable behind-the-scenes organiser. Smart Falcon's line about an 8-hour live-show talk with her suggests she gets very passionate about concerts.

story_arc.summary: Scenario NPC, not a trainee. In the Grand Live scenario she leads the project to revive the once-prestigious Grand Live concert, working with the trainer and Smart Falcon so the runners can perform. Her support-card event titles move from routine check-ins ('連絡が届いた！', 'お疲れ様です……！') to a moon-themed series ('嵐の大洋で、まどろみ', 'ティコの輝き', 'ホイヘンス山、越えし君', '虹の入り江にて'), lunar place names that fit the fan theory she is modelled on the horse Moonlight Rose.
